description: WO-D1's round trip, expressed as a WO-D2 scenario. It proves the driver can drive the seam that already exists, and it is the scenario every later one is built on: if the bridge does not carry a message, nothing downstream means anything.

assert.note: the app ran the scenario to the end and left a result behind
the served app answered 200 — did-finish-load fires for a 404 too
the page came from the served app, not about:blank or a file
there is a rendered document, not an empty shell
the reply came from the process that wrote this result, not from the page
driver -> renderer -> main: the handler saw a value this script minted
main -> renderer -> driver: a value the page had no way to invent

auditNote: fake-bridge is the one to read: echoes-driver-nonce stays GREEN under it, because a stub in the page can echo whatever it is handed. The echo was never the evidence — the nonce minted in main is. The three page assertions stay green under no-bridge, which is how we know the bridge assertions are not just re-testing the page load.
